sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This course provides the understanding of Equilibrium Electrochemistry and to enable students to understand the kinetics of electron transfer reactions at the electrode/electrolyte interface.
sections.Learning outcomes: A discuss how electrochemical potential arises B understand the difference between galvanic cells and electrolytic cells C use half-cell reactions to evaluate cell potential D discuss the thermodynamic relationships associated with electrochemical cells E understand the formation of electrochemical double layer F discuss mass transport in electrochemical cells G understand kinetics of heterogeneous electron transfer
